previewText: Gwinnett County market notes, Duluth Multicultural Week, On Golden Pond in Sugar Hill, and a late-summer laundry reset.

paragraphs: August is wrapping up, but the calendar still feels full. Between school routines, late-summer heat, and the first hints of fall plans, this is a good week to handle one small home task before September arrives.
This week's quick check takes only a few minutes, and the local calendar has several easy ways to get out around Gwinnett this weekend.

market.title: Gwinnett County market snapshot for July 2026
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: Realtor.com reported 3,802 active listings in Gwinnett County during July 2026, 8.5% higher from one year earlier.
The median listing price was $457,000. Median days on market came in at 50 days, 8.7% higher year over year.
For homeowners, the useful takeaway is that local conditions matter. Price, preparation, and neighborhood-level competition still shape the result for any individual home.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data for July 2026.

rotatingFeatures.label: COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT
rotatingFeatures.title: Multicultural Week in Downtown Duluth
paragraphs: Downtown Duluth is closing August with several free community events celebrating cultures from around the world. Friday's Rock the Block: Multicultural Night is scheduled for 6:00 to 9:00 PM with cultural performances and international food trucks, followed by creativity workshops on Sunday.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Review the event page before leaving because some Sunday workshops require registration.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: Explore Gwinnett event listing for Multicultural Week in Downtown Duluth.

rotatingFeatures.label: WEEKEND IDEA
rotatingFeatures.title: On Golden Pond at The Eagle Theatre
rotatingFeatures.availability: Friday, August 28 through Sunday, August 30, 2026, with additional performances September 4-6.
rotatingFeatures.driveTimeFromGwinnett: about 20 to 40 minutes from central Gwinnett
paragraphs: Players Guild opens its production of On Golden Pond at The Eagle Theatre this weekend. The classic American comedy-drama has performances Friday evening, twice Saturday, and Sunday afternoon.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Check the event page for tickets and final showtimes before heading out.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: Explore Gwinnett event listing for Players Guild Presents: On Golden Pond, August 28-September 6, 2026.

cartoon.caption: "The missing-sock investigation finally has a lead."
cartoon.closing: Clean airflow and one mystery solved.
cartoon.imagePrompt: A bright, family-friendly 16:9 editorial cartoon in a suburban laundry room. A cheerful homeowner discovers a single missing sock stuck to the outside of a clean dryer lint screen, with folded towels and a laundry basket nearby. Warm late-summer daylight, polished colorful newspaper-cartoon style, no logos and no text in the artwork.
